metadata.title: {appName}: every photo from your event, in one place

home.title: Every photo from your event, finally together.

settings.title: Album settings
settings.subtitle: Who sees the photos, and when your guests can upload.

danger.title: Delete the event
danger.description: The album, photos and videos are permanently deleted after 7 days. You can cancel during that time.

danger.pendingDescription: This event is no longer available to guests. Everything is permanently deleted on that date.
